name: Mode: Last Stand
author: Sixth Front
description: Hold out against 10 waves of raiders. Each wave is bigger and tougher than the last, and they come from the south and the flanks. Your team shares 50 lives, and the last few raiders of each wave show up on your minimap. Survive every wave to win. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.
script: wave = 0; pending = 0; horde.clear(); phase = 'break'; next = api.time() + 10;
// the enemy team only comes in waves
for (const s of api.soldiers()) if (s.team === 1) api.removeBot(s);
if (eb) eb.textContent = 'LAST STAND  ·  ' + api.config.MAP.name + '  ·  ' + WAVES + ' WAVES';
const b = api.spawnBot(1, { x: sp[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24, z: sp[1] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
// Raiders don't redeploy: they leave the battle when they die
// the last few raiders of a wave show up on your minimap
if (phase === 'fight' && pending === 0 && horde.size <= 3) for (const s of horde) { s.spottedUntil = now + 1; s.miniUntil = now + 1; }
const text = phase === 'break' ? `WAVE ${wave + 1}/${WAVES} IN ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(next - api.time()))}s`
api.hud.text('ls', text, { x: 50, y: 17, size: 0.75, color: phase === 'fight' ? '#ff4b3a' : '#7ce35b' });
